title: Diagnostic Billing
list.description: Load a confirmed investigation order, apply approved discount and collect payment.
invoice.description: Invoice lines, discount authorization, payments and outstanding due.
receipt.description: Cash memo for the recorded payment.
hints.discountReason: A reason is mandatory for every discount and is preserved in the audit trail.
hints.priceSnapshot: Rates are snapshotted when the invoice is created and are unaffected by later catalog changes.
hints.doctorInvestigations: Search by patient ID to load finalized doctor investigations automatically — do not re-type tests.
hints.idempotency: Submitting twice will not post the payment twice.
hints.reconciliation: Gross − Discount = Net. Net − Paid = Due.
hints.postPaymentDiscount: This invoice already has payment. Changing the discount is recorded as an authorized correction.
messages.invoiceExists: Invoice already exists for this order.
messages.confirmCancelInvoice: Cancel this invoice? This cannot be undone.
messages.confirmReversePayment: Reverse this payment? This will be recorded as a correction.
errors.INVOICE_CROSS_TENANT: This invoice belongs to another organization.
errors.INVOICE_BRANCH_ACCESS_DENIED: This invoice belongs to another branch.
errors.INVOICE_INVALID_STATUS: This action is not allowed for the current invoice status.
errors.INVOICE_EMPTY: The investigation order has no billable test.
errors.INVOICE_ALREADY_EXISTS: An invoice already exists for this order.
errors.INVOICE_STATE_CHANGED: The invoice changed since it was loaded. Reload and try again.
errors.INVOICE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: A test on this order is not available at this branch.
errors.INVOICE_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: A test on this order is not linked to the price list. Link it in the catalog before billing.
errors.DISCOUNT_NOT_PERMITTED: You are not permitted to authorize a discount.
errors.DISCOUNT_EXCEEDS_GROSS: Discount cannot exceed the discountable amount.
errors.DISCOUNT_INVALID_PERCENTAGE: Discount percentage must be between 0 and 100.
errors.DISCOUNT_BELOW_PAID_AMOUNT: Net amount cannot fall below the amount already paid.
errors.DISCOUNT_SERVICE_NOT_DISCOUNTABLE: No test on this invoice allows a discount.
errors.PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_DUE: Payment cannot exceed the due amount.
